About Us

A Brand-New Shop, Done Right

Prime Fade Studio opened its doors in October 2026 on 92 Avenue in Surrey. We're a brand-new barbershop built around one simple idea: premium fades and cuts, done properly, in a clean and welcoming space. Whether it's your regular cut or a whole new look, walk-ins and appointments are welcome — come be one of our first regulars.
